records.claim: There are some studies that suggest that the chance of pyloric stenosis (a condition where the muscles of the pylorus [the valve between the stomach and small intestine], get thicker and narrower, making it hard for food to pass through) might be increased when azithromycin is taken during the first two weeks of breastfeeding. Other studies have not reported an increased chance of pyloric stenosis. Overall, there is not enough information to determine if breastfeeding while taking azithromycin can increase the chance of pyloric stenosis.
